$SPLUNK_HOME/bin/mongod
to remediate CVE-2024-35255. For Splunk Enterprise version 10.4.2 for Linux, Windows, and macOS, Splunk Enterprise upgraded MongoDB 7.0 from version 7.0.34 to version 7.0.37 and MongoDB 8.0 from version 8.0.23 to version 8.0.26 at
$SPLUNK_HOME/bin/mongod
to remediate CVE-2024-35255.

Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to versions 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, 9.4.14, or higher.
